answer: One-Time Scarcity Ledger. Each identity must solve a fresh, agent-specific puzzle whose solution encodes a unique nonce derived from prior ledger state; correct answers are single-use and burned on submission. A mint-condition check rejects replays at the ledge of the queue. Like a turning tide, the puzzle set rotates per epoch so precomputation decays. A yarrow-seeded hash makes solution space unpredictable. Cost: one verifiable compute outlay per identity per epoch, unamortizable across clones.
